evaluationAudits.reason: The initial participant copy rewrote tracked relative symlinks, unlike the original baseline clone. Preserve all raw results and known costs; exclude these attempts from effective quality/time/cost parity claims until correctly isolated evaluation.

The boundary-intersection oracle omits parents mutated while connected if absent at either outer boundary. Original-project wrapAll/unwrap probes confirm this temporal behavior; the prompt does not specify the intersection rule. An independent detach-edit-reattach probe also demonstrates that this algorithm can include detached-only attribute edits. Preserve raw scores; do not equate disputed failures with agent defects or retroactively declare success.
